definition: Multichannel Speaking Automaton (MUSA) was an early prototype of Speech Synthesis machine started in 1975..
details: Multichannel Speaking Automaton (MUSA) was an early prototype of Speech Synthesis machine started in 1975.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Multichannel Speaking Automaton — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
